clips.video_generation_prompt: Ultra-premium CGI commercial hero product reveal for Nestle NAN COMFOR (16:9). Seamless first-to-last frame interpolation starting exactly as FRAME-1. STRICT BRAND PRESERVATION: Preserve exact package geometry, proportions, scale, label placement, typography, NAN COMFOR brand identity, magenta-to-purple background gradient. Maintain perfect packaging legibility at every frame. Preserve the stylized white bird with magenta outlines exactly as shown on packaging artwork. CREATIVE DIRECTION: Minimal premium virtual studio with branded magenta-purple gradient background, luminous circular arcs, molecular structures, soft hexagonal overlays, floating light particles. Ultra-premium advertising CGI, clean luxury composition, high micro-contrast, product-first framing. 70mm full-frame lens, continuous sharp focus on products, locked frontal camera position. Large diffused frontal key light, low-intensity magenta ambient fill, subtle magenta-violet rim light defining cylindrical metal can edges. TIMELINE EXECUTION (0.00s-8.00s): 0.00s-0.80s: Scene opens on empty branded magenta-purple background matching FRAME-1. Futuristic interface graphics, circular arcs, molecular nodes, fine luminous lines, and floating particles drift inward from lateral edges. Locked camera. 0.80s-1.70s: The stylized white bird with magenta outline rises from behind the camera. Large wing passes close to lens creating a clean foreground wipe. Fast creative crash zoom follows the bird briefly before returning to locked hero framing. Bird flies toward center with controlled wingbeats. 1.70s-2.60s: Rear-left NAN COMFOR package rises vertically from central glow, easing into rear-left position. Metallic reflections stabilize. 2.60s-3.50s: Rear-right NAN COMFOR package emerges from central glow, rises vertically and settles into mirrored rear-right position. 3.50s-4.50s: Front-center NAN COMFOR package rises with a strong luminous pulse and settles into foreground hero position. No subtitles, no text overlay.
